name: Philips
summary: Philips describes three phases on its careers site: application and first assessment, interviews, and decisions. A recruiter contacts you if your profile fits, usually for a screening call about your background and career interests, and later rounds are with the hiring manager and team members, in person or by video; the number varies by role, location and manager. Philips recruiters advise preparing specific examples of your impact and saying 'I did this' rather than 'we did this'.
rounds: Application and first assessment of your profile
Screening call with Talent Acquisition about your background and career interests
Interviews with the hiring manager and team members, in person or by video
Further interviews or assessments for some roles
looks_for: Genuine interest in Philips and the role

questions.text: Tell me about a project you're proud of. What exactly did you do?
Tell me about a time you put the end user or patient first.
covers: Who they were and what they needed

questions.text: Tell me about a time you had to work across teams or countries.
covers: Who was involved and the challenge

questions.text: Why did you move on from your last role?
covers: Why this role is the right next step

questions.text: How would you make sure a new medical device feature is safe before it launches?
A hospital customer reports that a device keeps showing an error. What do you do?
covers: Gathering details and checking for safety risk

questions.text: How would you improve a home health product for older users?
covers: Design changes and testing with them

questions.text: How do you balance speed and quality in your work?
How would you use data to show the value of a product to hospital buyers?
covers: Outcomes they care about: time, cost, patient results

questions.text: Walk me through how you'd learn a regulated field you're new to.
covers: Key rules and standards to learn first

questions.text: Why do you want to work at Philips?
covers: What draws you to Philips's focus on health
How your experience fits the role

questions.text: What questions do you have about the role or team?
covers: What the first months look like

tips: Philips recruiters suggest saying 'I did this' rather than 'we did this' when describing past work.
Study the job description and match your examples to its key skills.
For video interviews, join five minutes early, keep your camera on and treat it like an in-person meeting, as Philips advises.
Philips warns about people falsely recruiting in its name; apply only through its official careers site.

sources.title: Philips Careers: Ace your next interview, tips from Philips recruiters
